about.value: T's Brunch Bar in Atlanta, GA. T's Brunch Bar introduces Brunch with a twist! Owner Teneshia Murray is a serial entrepreneur that loves brunch foods and she wants a twist of mimosas, breakfast and brunch foods added to her list of business! Our menu will have all types of different brunch foods with a little touch of southern! Chef Jamarious Gilmere created all of Teneshia's favorite brunch foods and added a twist to each entree! Our food is cooked fresh to order and have great flavor with amazing taste! We look forward to serving you!
